AdjacentRatio.description: Irregular when a storey's value is more than ``adjacent`` × an adjacent storey's.
AdjacentRatio.title: AdjacentRatio

CsLimits.description:
Bounds of the seismic response coefficient Cs of the equivalent lateral force method:
Cs ≥ max(``sdsFactor``·SDS·Ie, ``floor``) and, where S1 ≥ ``nearFaultS1``,
Cs ≥ ``nearFaultFactor``·S1 / (R/Ie).
CsLimits.title: CsLimits

DampingCorrection.description:
The spectrum's damping correction η(ξ). ``squareRoot``: η = √(numerator / (offset +
100ξ)), at least ``minimum``; ``none``: η = dampingEta.
DampingCorrection.title: DampingCorrection

DesignSpectrumRule.description:
The design spectrum: a method id the pack picks (C4, C1). Empty: ``reducedElastic``.

- ``reducedElastic`` (the default pack's): Sa = pgaFactor·Z·I/R·Cs(T), Cs the elastic shape
  of the site class (S, TB, TC, TD; :func:`saengine.fem.loads.design_acceleration`).
- ``behaviourFactor`` (EN 1998-1 3.2.2.5): ag = Z·I, Sd = ag·S·[2/3 + T/TB·(2.5/q - 2/3)] up
  to TB, ag·S·2.5/q to TC, ·TC/T to TD, ·TC·TD/T² beyond, at least ``lowerBound``·ag from TC
  (:mod:`saengine.fem.spectra`); R stands for q.
- ``mappedSpectral`` (ASCE 7-22 Ch 11-12, :mod:`saengine.fem.spectral_hazard`): the site's
  SDS and SD1 (and S1, TL) entered from the code's hazard tool (Site > Mapped spectral
  values) instead of a zone: a two-period spectrum (T0 = ``t0Share``·TS, TS = SD1/SDS;
  ``rampStart``·SDS at T = 0 up to SDS at T0, SDS to TS, SD1/T to TL, SD1·TL/T² beyond) or
  the site's multi-period design spectrum, × I/R; the equivalent lateral force coefficient
  Cs = SDS/(R/Ie) ≤ SD1/(T R/Ie) (SD1 TL/(T² R/Ie) beyond TL) within ``csLimits``; the
  Seismic Design Category read by the band of SDS and SD1 (``sdsBands``, ``sd1Bands``, the
  more severe; the band after the last where S1 ≥ ``s1Extreme``) as zone packs read it by
  zone; the period's upper limit Cu·Ta from ``periodUpper`` by SD1. The fields after
  ``lowerBound`` are this method's.

designShare.description: SDS = share × SMS, SD1 = share × SM1 (mapped values).
designShare.title: Designshare

rampStart.description: Sa at T = 0 as a share of SDS (the ramp to T0).
rampStart.title: Rampstart

sdsBands.description: SDS [g] at which each band from the second starts.
sdsBands.title: Sdsbands

sd1Bands.description: SD1 [g] at which each band from the second starts.
sd1Bands.title: Sd1Bands

s1Extreme.description: S1 [g] from which the band after the last one applies.
s1Extreme.title: S1Extreme

periodUpper.description: (SD1 [g], Cu) points: T ≤ Cu·Ta, Cu linear between, held beyond.
periodUpper.title: Periodupper

DesignSpectrumRule.title: DesignSpectrumRule

DiaphragmConnections.description:
The connection force increase of irregular buildings (the factor is the pack's
``transfer.diaphragm.irregularIncrease``): in the ``categories`` with an irregularity of
``types``. ``wingTypes``: irregularities whose projecting wings need chords and collectors
for independent motion, satisfied by a dynamic 3D analysis when ``wingsDynamicExempt``.
DiaphragmConnections.title: DiaphragmConnections

DiaphragmDeflection.description:
In-plane diaphragm deflection limit [mm]; empty: the code gives no number (the
permissible deflection of the attached elements, which the engineer enters).
DiaphragmDeflection.title: DiaphragmDeflection

DriftLimit.description:
A row of the allowable storey drift table; the first row whose conditions hold applies
(a condition left empty always holds), else ``allowableDrift``.

masonry.description: The system is a masonry one.
masonry.title: Masonry

cantileverWalls.description: The walls are cantilevered from the base (no coupling).
cantileverWalls.title: Cantileverwalls

driftTolerantFinishes.description: Interior walls, partitions, ceilings and exterior walls designed to accommodate the storey drift.
driftTolerantFinishes.title: Drifttolerantfinishes

DriftLimit.title: DriftLimit

DynamicAnalysis.description:
When the equivalent static method is not enough. ``regularHeights`` and
``irregularHeights``: height [m] above which dynamic analysis is required, by seismic zone
("1".."4"); ``recommendedIrregular``: zones where it is recommended for an irregular building
below that height. The static procedure also needs T below ``periodTcFactor`` × TC and
``periodMax`` and no vertical irregularity (``verticalIrregularity``).
DynamicAnalysis.title: DynamicAnalysis

Irregularities.description: Plan and vertical irregularity thresholds (each block empty: not checked).
Irregularities.title: Irregularities

LateralForceRule.description:
C4: the lateral force method. Base shear × ``correction`` when T ≤ ``periodTcFactor``·TC
and the building has more than ``minStoreys`` - 1 storeys (EN 1998-1 4.3.3.2.2 λ = 0.85);
``distribution``: ``heightPower`` (Fx ∝ wx·hx^k, k 1 to 2 with T) or ``linear`` (Fi ∝ zi·mi,
EN 1998-1 4.3.3.2.3 with the linear mode shape).
LateralForceRule.title: LateralForceRule

MultiPeriodRule.description:
SMS and SM1 from a multi-period MCER spectrum (Sa [g] by T [s]): SMS = ``smsShare`` ×
the largest Sa from ``smsPeriods[0]`` to ``smsPeriods[1]``, at least Sa at the first;
SM1 = the largest T·Sa from ``sm1Periods[0]`` to ``sm1Periods[1]`` (``sm1PeriodsSoft`` for
the ``softClasses``); SDS, SD1 = ``designShare`` × them. Used when the project gives the
MCER spectrum and not SDS and SD1.
MultiPeriodRule.title: MultiPeriodRule

Separation.description:
Separation from adjacent structures: the gap to the property line is at least
``propertyLineFactor``·δ; between units of one property the ``sameProperty`` combination
("srss" or "sum") of the two δ; times ``equalFloorLevelsFactor`` where the floors align.
Separation.title: Separation

vs30.description: (lower, upper) average shear wave speed of the top 30 m [m/s] of the class, where the code defines the class by it; empty: by the description.
vs30.title: Vs30

SiteSpecificStudy.description: Site classes the code gives no spectrum for: they need a site-specific study.
SiteSpecificStudy.title: SiteSpecificStudy

SoftStoreyDesign.description:
Design of a soft storey without the overstrength factor. ``forceFactors``: the soft
storey's columns and beams take ``frameFactor`` × the earthquake forces, its structural walls
``wallFactor`` ×; ``types``: the irregularity types that make a storey soft.
SoftStoreyDesign.title: SoftStoreyDesign

StabilityRule.description:
θ, a method id (C4, C1). ``elasticOverImportance`` (the default pack's): θ = Px δe/(I Vx
h), θmax = 0.5/Cd ≤ ``thetaCap``; ``elasticDrift`` (ASCE 7-22 Eq 12.8-16, θ = Px Δ Ie/(Vx
hsx Cd) with Δ = Cd δe/Ie): θ = Px δe/(Vx h), θmax = 0.5/Cd ≤ ``thetaCap``; ``designDrift``
(EN 1998-1 4.4.2.2): θ = Ptot dr/(Vtot h) with dr = Cd·de (Cd standing for qd), θmax =
``thetaCap``. Below ``ignoreBelow`` second order effects need not be taken into account; up
to ``amplifyUpTo`` they may be by 1/(1 - θ).
StabilityRule.title: StabilityRule

StoreyRatio.description:
A storey irregular when its value is below ``storeyAbove`` × the storey above's, or
below ``threeAbove`` × the mean of the three storeys above (empty: not checked).
StoreyRatio.title: StoreyRatio

StoreyStrength.description:
How a storey's lateral strength is estimated for the weak storey check. ``shearStrength``:
the sum of the nominal shear strengths of the storey's columns and structural walls in the
direction, Vn = concreteFactor·λ·√f'c·bw·d + Av·fyt·d/s, d = depthFactor × the depth.
StoreyStrength.title: StoreyStrength

row.description: Row of the code's system table.
row.title: Row

masonry.description: A masonry system: its walls are designed as masonry.
masonry.title: Masonry

group.description: Group of the code's system table (bearingWall, dualSpecial...).
group.title: Group

dual.description: A dual system (one row of the table).
dual.title: Dual

SystemCombination.description: How the values of several systems in one direction combine: "min" or "max".
SystemCombination.title: SystemCombination

TimeHistoryRules.description:
Ground motion suites of the response history procedures (B19; B36 for the nonlinear
target). ``method``: how a suite is scaled (``periodRange``: the mean spectrum of the
records, or of the pairs' SRSS spectra, is not below ``singleRatio`` / ``pairRatio`` times
the target spectrum at every period from ``periodLower``·T to ``periodUpper``·T, the
spectra ``spectrumDamping`` damped); ``minimumRecords`` per suite; ``meanFrom``: from this
many records (or pairs) the design value is the mean of their peaks, fewer the largest;
``baseShearShare``: the responses are scaled by share·V/Vth where the suite's base shear
Vth is below share·V (the equivalent static V); ``scaleDrifts``: that factor also on the
displacements and drifts; ``simultaneousPairs``: a pair's components act together (no
orthogonal 100 % + 30 % rule); ``targets``: by procedure (``linear``, ``nonlinear``).
TimeHistoryRules.title: TimeHistoryRules

TimeHistoryTarget.description:
The spectrum records are scaled to: the design spectrum with ``R`` and ``I`` (empty: the
building's own).
TimeHistoryTarget.title: TimeHistoryTarget

description: Site classes, spectrum, systems, SDC and the plain numbers of the seismic analysis.

source.description: Clause (and page) the table comes from.
source.title: Source

sources.description: Clause references of single entries: {key: clause}.
sources.title: Sources

clauses.description: Clause references of the seismic results, by key.
clauses.title: Clauses

driftLimits.description: Rows of the drift table before allowableDrift.
driftLimits.title: Driftlimits

driftRedundancyCategories.description: Seismic Design Categories where the drift limit of systems of moment frames only is divided by the redundancy factor ρ.
driftRedundancyCategories.title: Driftredundancycategories

liveShare.description: Share of the floor live load in the seismic weight.
liveShare.title: Liveshare

heavyLiveLimit.description: Live loads above this [kN/m²] count in the seismic weight with heavyLiveShare (empty: every live load with liveShare).
heavyLiveLimit.title: Heavylivelimit

heavyLiveShare.description: Share of a heavy live load in the seismic weight.
heavyLiveShare.title: Heavyliveshare

partitionWeight.description: How the area loads' partition allowance counts in the seismic weight: full (100 %, like the dead load; the live share and its threshold use the floor live load without it) or withLiveShare (as live load, the threshold judged on the live load with it). Empty: the generic default (full).
partitionWeight.title: Partitionweight

periodUpperFactor.description: A period from the structure's properties is at most this times the approximate period Ta (empty: 1.4).
periodUpperFactor.title: Periodupperfactor

minimumScale.description: Least share of the static base shear for RS.
minimumScale.title: Minimumscale

stabilityGravity.description: D6: load case -> factor of the gravity load Px of the stability coefficient θ; empty: the generic default (codes/generic), named in the report.
stabilityGravity.title: Stabilitygravity

spectrumType.description: Id of the spectrum of ``spectra`` whose site parameters become ``siteClasses`` (EN 1998-1 Type 1 or Type 2); a project chooses another by overriding this value. Empty: ``siteClasses`` as given.
spectrumType.title: Spectrumtype

spectra.description: Site parameters (S, TB, TC, TD) by spectrum type id, then site class.
spectra.title: Spectra

designSpectrum.description: How the design spectrum follows from the elastic one; empty: reducedElastic, Sa = pgaFactor·Z·I/R·Cs(T).

lateralForce.description: The base shear correction and the distribution of the lateral force method; empty: no correction, Fx ∝ wx·hx^k with k from the period.

driftAmplification.description: Design displacements from the elastic ones: overImportance (Cd·δe/I) or displacementFactor (qd·de, Cd standing for qd, the importance already in de). Empty: overImportance.
driftAmplification.title: Driftamplification

stability.description: The interstorey drift sensitivity coefficient θ; empty: θ = Px δe/(I Vx h) with θmax = 0.5/Cd ≤ 0.25.

title: SeismicTable
